tools.name: search
tools.title: Search accounts and contacts
tools.description: Find accounts (companies) and contacts (people) in the workspace by name, domain, title, email or company. Returns ids like 'account:<id>' and 'contact:<id>' to pass to fetch.

tools.name: fetch
tools.title: Get one record
tools.description: Everything about one record by its id: an account with its fit score, recent buying signals and contacts; a contact with their company and email status; a list with its members; a campaign with its results; a reply waiting on the reply desk; a queued call's pre-call brief; a person in the team's network with who can introduce them; or a Populate run's progress.

id.description: '<kind>:<id>', kind being account, contact, list, campaign, reply, call, person or populate.

tools.name: list_signals
tools.title: List buying signals
tools.description: Recent buying signals (funding, hiring, leadership changes, launches, news), newest first, for the workspace or one account. Signal titles and summaries come from the public web.

kind.description: One kind, e.g. funding or hiring.

tools.name: list_inbox
tools.title: List inbox tasks
tools.description: The prioritized follow-ups in the inbox: what to do next and why.

mine.description: Only tasks assigned to the user (and unassigned ones).

tools.name: list_lists
tools.title: List saved lists
tools.description: The workspace's saved lists of accounts or contacts, with their sizes.

tools.name: list_campaigns
tools.title: List campaigns
tools.description: The user's outreach campaigns and their status, to choose one for add_contacts_to_campaign.

tools.name: get_credit_balance
tools.title: Get credit balance
tools.description: The workspace's credit balance and its most recent movements. Research tools spend credits.

tools.name: prospector_search
tools.title: Search the prospect database
tools.description: Search a B2B database of people and companies who are NOT necessarily in the workspace, by title, seniority, company, location, size, revenue, industry, keywords or technology. Free: emails, phones, domains and LinkedIn pages come back masked. Rows already in the workspace are marked saved.

scope.description: net_new skips people and companies already in the workspace.

filters.description: Filters, all optional, AND across keys: first_name, last_name, titles, departments, seniorities, company_names, company_domains, person_countries, person_states, person_cities, person_zips, company_countries, company_states, company_cities, company_zips, employee_sizes, revenue_ranges, industries, exclude_industries, sub_industries, exclude_sub_industries, sic_codes, keywords, exclude_keywords, technologies (each a list of up to 50 strings), has_direct_phone (contacts) and has_linkedin (companies) as booleans.

cursor.description: next_cursor from a net_new search, to keep scanning.

tools.name: get_workspace_overview
tools.title: Get the workspace overview
tools.description: Start here for 'what should I work on?': the dashboard's numbers (for a rep, their own work), today's prioritized engagement actions, and the workspace's ideal customer profile.

tools.name: list_queue
tools.title: List alerts, replies or calls
tools.description: A work queue: 'alerts' (signals worth acting on), 'replies' (buyer replies waiting for a decision on the reply desk) or 'calls' (the call list).

mine.description: Calls only: just the user's own.

tools.name: search_network
tools.title: Search the team's network
tools.description: Who the team knows: people in teammates' connected contacts and calendars matching a description (e.g. 'CFOs at fintechs in London'), with the strength of the best connection. Only connections shared with the user are searched.

tools.name: find_contacts
tools.title: Find contacts at an account
tools.description: Find the buying committee at an account: new people matching the workspace's target titles, with verified emails where one can be found. Found people are saved to the account. Costs credits, as in the app; the balance is checked first.

request_id.description: Optional. Reuse the same value when retrying this exact call, so it is answered from the first attempt instead of running (and charging) twice.

tools.name: find_similar_companies
tools.title: Find similar companies
tools.description: Companies similar to an account, scored against the workspace's ideal customer profile. Nothing is added; use create_account for the ones to keep. Costs credits, as in the app; the balance is checked first.

request_id.description: Optional. Reuse the same value when retrying this exact call, so it is answered from the first attempt instead of running (and charging) twice.

tools.name: enrich_contact
tools.title: Enrich a contact
tools.description: Find and verify a contact's work email (and phone where available) and save it to the contact. Costs credits, as in the app; the balance is checked first.

request_id.description: Optional. Reuse the same value when retrying this exact call, so it is answered from the first attempt instead of running (and charging) twice.

tools.name: research_account
tools.title: Research an account
tools.description: A research brief on an account: what the company does, recent signals, and talking points tied to the workspace's value propositions. Costs credits, as in the app; the balance is checked first.

request_id.description: Optional. Reuse the same value when retrying this exact call, so it is answered from the first attempt instead of running (and charging) twice.

tools.name: draft_email
tools.title: Draft an email to a contact
tools.description: Write a short cold email to a contact from their company's signals and the workspace's value propositions and email style. Returns subject and body. Nothing is sent or saved. Costs credits, as in the app; the balance is checked first.

guidance.description: Optional angle or instruction for this draft.

request_id.description: Optional. Reuse the same value when retrying this exact call, so it is answered from the first attempt instead of running (and charging) twice.

annotations.title: Draft an email to a contact

tools.name: enrich_account
tools.title: Enrich an account
tools.description: Fill in a company's firmographics (industry, size, location, revenue, tech stack, LinkedIn page) from public sources and save them to the account. Costs credits, as in the app; the balance is checked first.

request_id.description: Optional. Reuse the same value when retrying this exact call, so it is answered from the first attempt instead of running (and charging) twice.

tools.name: verify_email
tools.title: Verify a contact's email
tools.description: Re-check a contact's saved email with a live mailbox check. A valid, risky or catch-all address is kept; an invalid or missing one starts a search for the right address, charged as enriching a contact instead. Costs credits, as in the app; the balance is checked first.

request_id.description: Optional. Reuse the same value when retrying this exact call, so it is answered from the first attempt instead of running (and charging) twice.

tools.name: find_phone
tools.title: Find a contact's phone number
tools.description: Look up a contact's direct phone number and save it to the contact. A number already found is answered without a new search. Costs credits, as in the app; the balance is checked first.

request_id.description: Optional. Reuse the same value when retrying this exact call, so it is answered from the first attempt instead of running (and charging) twice.

tools.name: refresh_account
tools.title: Refresh an account now
tools.description: Collect the latest buying signals for an account now (news, hiring, funding, the company's own site) and re-score it, instead of waiting for its scheduled refresh. Can take a minute. Costs credits, as in the app; the balance is checked first.

request_id.description: Optional. Reuse the same value when retrying this exact call, so it is answered from the first attempt instead of running (and charging) twice.

tools.name: find_similar_people
tools.title: Find people similar to a contact
tools.description: People who resemble a contact (role, seniority, kind of company). mode 'existing' ranks the workspace's own contacts and is free; mode 'new' finds people outside the workspace and is charged for each one returned. Costs credits, as in the app; the balance is checked first.

request_id.description: Optional. Reuse the same value when retrying this exact call, so it is answered from the first attempt instead of running (and charging) twice.

annotations.title: Find people similar to a contact

tools.name: add_icp_companies
tools.title: Add companies matching the ICP
tools.description: Add up to the given number of NEW companies matching the workspace's ideal customer profile, as the Relevance page's Populate does. Needs a saved profile; runs in the background. Use get_workspace_overview to see the profile first, and confirm the count with the user. Costs credits, as in the app; the balance is checked first.

tools.name: draft_reply
tools.title: Draft a reply to a buyer
tools.description: Suggest an answer to a reply waiting on the reply desk (from list_queue kind 'replies'), written from the conversation and the workspace's style. Nothing is sent or saved. Costs credits, as in the app; the balance is checked first.

request_id.description: Optional. Reuse the same value when retrying this exact call, so it is answered from the first attempt instead of running (and charging) twice.

annotations.title: Draft a reply to a buyer

tools.name: create_campaign_draft
tools.title: Create a campaign draft
tools.description: Create an outreach campaign as a DRAFT sending from the user's own mailbox: who it goes to (a saved list, contacts, or everyone with an email at accounts), its steps (a sequence template, or an opening email and one follow-up), and, unless told not to, its opening emails written for review. Never approves, launches or sends. Costs credits, as in the app; the balance is checked first.

list_id.description: A saved list: its people, or everyone at its companies.

template_id.description: A sequence template's id for the steps.

request_id.description: Optional. Reuse the same value when retrying this exact call, so it is answered from the first attempt instead of running (and charging) twice.

tools.name: create_account
tools.title: Add an account
tools.description: Add a company to the workspace. Give its website domain whenever known: the domain is how the product tells companies apart and collects their signals.

tools.name: create_list
tools.title: Create a list
tools.description: Create a saved list of accounts or of contacts, optionally with its first members.

tools.name: add_to_list
tools.title: Add to a list
tools.description: Add accounts to an account list, or contacts to a contact list.

tools.name: remove_from_list
tools.title: Remove from a list
tools.description: Take accounts or contacts off a list the user may change. Only the list membership goes: the records stay in the workspace.

tools.name: add_contacts_to_campaign
tools.title: Add contacts to a campaign
tools.description: Add people to a campaign: named contacts, everyone with an email at named accounts, or a whole list. Nothing is sent: drafts wait for the user's review in the app.

tools.name: complete_inbox_task
tools.title: Complete an inbox task
tools.description: Mark an inbox task done.

tools.name: save_email_draft
tools.title: Save an email to Drafts
tools.description: Put an email to a contact in the user's own mailbox Drafts folder, signed as they sign, for them to review and send. Never sends.

tools.name: prospector_save
tools.title: Save prospects to the workspace
tools.description: Save rows from prospector_search into the workspace (or onto a list), or add the people's companies to an account list. Costs credits per email, direct phone (only with include_phones) or company delivered, each charged once; the balance is checked first. Pass the same view, scope and filters as the search.

scope.description: net_new skips people and companies already in the workspace.

filters.description: Filters, all optional, AND across keys: first_name, last_name, titles, departments, seniorities, company_names, company_domains, person_countries, person_states, person_cities, person_zips, company_countries, company_states, company_cities, company_zips, employee_sizes, revenue_ranges, industries, exclude_industries, sub_industries, exclude_sub_industries, sic_codes, keywords, exclude_keywords, technologies (each a list of up to 50 strings), has_direct_phone (contacts) and has_linkedin (companies) as booleans.

all_matching_limit.description: Instead of rows: everything matching, up to this many.

request_id.description: Optional. Reuse the same value when retrying this exact call, so it is answered from the first attempt instead of running (and charging) twice.

tools.name: acknowledge_alert
tools.title: Acknowledge an alert
tools.description: Mark an alert from list_queue as seen, so it leaves the open queue.

tools.name: save_reply_draft
tools.title: Save a reply to Drafts
tools.description: Put an answer to a reply-desk reply in the user's own mailbox Drafts, in the same thread, for them to review and send. Never sends.

tools.name: queue_call
tools.title: Queue a call
tools.description: Put a call on the user's call list for an account (and a contact there), with an AI call script. Never dials.

contact_id.description: The person to call, if known.

reason.description: Why call now, e.g. the signal that prompted it.

tools.name: log_call_outcome
tools.title: Log a call's outcome
tools.description: Record how a call from the call list went (connected, voicemail, meeting booked, ...), with notes and the next step. No answer, callback and gatekeeper keep the call on the list; the others close it.
